modalLead: A hotfix on top of v2026.09.09, tidying up the check-mode popover in Health.

items.text: The check-mode popover had become a form. Three releases added to it, and on a monitored row five of its fifteen controls — Save among them — sat below a scrollbar. The menu picks a mode again; expectations, drift watching and muting open in the row's own panel, where the fields get the row's full width and every control is on screen.
